summary: Positive-count object references keep the private container alive; delete when no longer needed.
Deleting a reference is permitted with a pending JS exception.
Duplicate same-hook/argument registration or unmatched removal can abort; exact registration state is mandatory.
Teardown may occur with JS disabled; manual cleanup hooks precede finalizers.
The helper cleanup path only deletes its reference under its owning env and mutex; it calls no JS.
